d: We are looking for the right person to join our team in Dammam as our new Pricing Specialist – Project & Breakbulk. Could it be you?
q: Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field. Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.
Experience in pricing Project Cargo and Breakbulk logistics.
Proven experience in Saudi Arabia, with extensive knowledge of local logistics markets, ports, transport regulations and project cargo requirements.
Proven experience handling heavy-lift, oversized and industrial cargo shipments.
Experience supporting tenders, RFQs and complex customer proposals.
Experience working with EPC contractors and projects within the energy, oil & gas, infrastructure or industrial sectors.
Existing network of carriers, transport companies and logistics service providers across Saudi Arabia.
Strong commercial negotiation and analytical skills.
Good understanding of Incoterms, shipping documentation and multimodal transport.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and freight management systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (Arabic will be considered an advantage).
Ability to work independently while effectively supporting business development and key account teams.

You will join the GAC Group, a global leader in shipping, logistics and marine services, and become part of a team that values innovation, collaboration and professional growth. As our Pricing Specialist – Project & Breakbulk in Saudi Arabia, you'll contribute to major logistics projects while working with experienced industry professionals in a dynamic and growth-oriented environment.
We're looking forward to hearing from you! 🚀

Please note that as well as working to recruit staff members via GAC channels, GAC uses third-party recruiters to recruit for specific positions within the Group. However, please be aware of unaffiliated recruiters purporting to represent GAC that ask for payment in return for facilitating interviews. A genuine third-party recruiter working with GAC will never ask for payment to facilitate an interview.
If you would like to make an application to join GAC, please always ensure to apply through our official channels on https://career.gac.com/ or our LinkedIn listing.
r: If appointed, you will play a key role in competitive pricing and profitable logistics solutions for project cargo, breakbulk and heavy-lift shipments across Saudi Arabia. You will work closely with customers, carriers and operations teams to help drive commercial growth through tailored transport solutions and effective cost management.
Prepare and submit competitive commercial proposals in response to RFQs, tenders and strategic business opportunities.
Develop end-to-end logistics solutions covering air, sea, land and port operations.
Negotiate rates and commercial terms with shipping lines, transport providers, heavy lift operators and subcontractors.
Work on RFQs, tenders and strategic customer bids with commercially viable pricing proposals.
Conducting cost analysis to ensure profitability and margin control.
Coordinate with operations teams to ensure offered solutions are operationally feasible and efficient.
Build and maintain strong relationships with carriers, transport companies and service providers.
Monitor and update market trends and freight rates.
Prepare monthly reports and analysis based on quoted, secured and lost business.
Ensuring timely responses to customer enquiries as per set KPI’s and business opportunities.
